text: `SuggestionsFor` examines available child commands and suggests a name when its case-insensitive Levenshtein distance from the input is at most `SuggestionsMinimumDistance`, when its name has the typed prefix case-insensitively, or when the input equals an entry in `SuggestFor` case-insensitively (`command.go:831-851`). `findSuggestions` disables this entirely via `DisableSuggestions`, defaults a nonpositive distance to 2, and formats the matches (`command.go:750-766`).
